mentions.name: canine.sh
mentions.description: Open source platform that turns a Kubernetes cluster into a developer-friendly PaaS, with a cloud version hosting over 2k apps and the option to run it locally.
mentions.problem: Kubernetes on its own is not developer-friendly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on canine.sh for about 2 years now.

It’s an open source project that basically turns your kubernetes into a developer friendly PaaS.
